answer: Live pulse bonds: every identity locks a small stake and must answer a fresh, unpredictable pulse challenge each epoch - a signature that cannot be precomputed or copied. Missed pulses decay the stake, so a sybil farm must keep thousands of fake identities awake and funded at once, like holding a dune against the wind. Peers weight trust by mesa-tall reputation earned only from sustained on-time pulses, so mass fakery costs more than honest participation.
